hints.title: Generate Fibonacci Numbers up to k
hints.text: Precompute all Fibonacci numbers that do not exceed k (up to ~10^9 requires about 45 numbers).

hints.title: Zeckendorfs Theorem
hints.text: Every positive integer can be uniquely represented as the sum of one or more non-consecutive Fibonacci numbers.

hints.title: Greedy Subtraction
hints.text: Always greedily subtract the largest Fibonacci number less than or equal to the remaining k, and increment step count.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Knapsack or recursion without greedy selection explores exponentially many sum combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since Fibonacci numbers grow exponentially, precomputing takes ~45 elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies greedy largest-first selection backed by Zeckendorf representation.
